summary: __stdcall helper that builds a plane equation from a point and a normal: copies the three normal components (a3[0..2]) into the output struct at a1+0/+4/+8, then stores the signed plane constant -(a2[0]*a3[0] + a2[1]*a3[1] + a2[2]*a3[2]) at a1+12, and returns a1. Equivalent to constructing the plane with the negated dot product of the point-on-plane vector a2 with the plane normal a3.

operations.description: Compute plane constant at a1 + 12: -(a2[1] * a3[1] + a2[2] * a3[2] + a2[0] * a3[0]), i.e. the negated dot product of the point vector a2 with the normal a3.
Return a1 (the output plane struct pointer), preserved in result before the writes.

clean_pseudocode: plane[3] = -(point[0] * normal[0] + point[1] * normal[1] + point[2] * normal[2]);
unresolved: Roles of a2 (point on the plane) and a3 (plane normal) are inferred from the canonical name and the negated dot-product form; the packet evidence does not independently label either vector.
Whether a2 is a normalized direction or an arbitrary point is not decidable from this function alone.
The a1+12 value is interpreted as the signed plane distance constant in ax+by+cz+d=0 form (DERIVED from the dot-product structure, not stated by the evidence).
